Stage 4 water restrictions remain in effect; most inner-canyon water sources are off, though South Kaibab Trailhead water remains on, and Grand Canyon National Park separately advises day hikers descend no farther than 1.5 miles from the upper trailhead due to elevated Inner Canyon heat risk regardless of warning status. No NWS Excessive Heat Warning is active for Grand Canyon country today; no active NWS alerts were found for the area today (Source: National Weather Service). north-kaibab-coconino.note: The entirety of North Kaibab Trail, Phantom Ranch (including Bright Angel Campground, the Canteen, and cabins), and the Black Bridge and Silver Bridge river crossings remain closed with no estimated reopening, confirmed unchanged today (Source: National Park Service). The National Park Service continues to warn that additional thunderstorms could bring further flash flooding, debris flows, and rockfall with little to no warning. No NWS Excessive Heat Warning is active for Grand Canyon country today; no active NWS alerts were found for the area today (Source: National Weather Service). Source: National Park Service, Grand Canyon National Park.
